errors.text_span: простираща до 60, с линейна скала с интервали от 10
errors.evidence: The vertical axis has labeled ticks at 0, 20, 40, and 60, making the intervals 20, not 10. The axis also extends beyond 60, as the tallest bar is over 70.
The bar for 'Full FT' clearly extends above the 60 GB line, to a value of approximately 72 GB.
The values for the last four bars are not progressively lower. For example, 'TAG' and 'LoRA' are approximately the same height, and 'Ours' is taller than 'QLoRA'.

errors.text_span: вариращи от приблизително 35 GB до 15 GB съответно
errors.evidence: The values for the last four bars (TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, Ours) are all in the approximate range of 13 GB to 22 GB, not 35 GB to 15 GB.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете QLoRA и Ours имат леко по-различна визуална окраска - QLoRA е жълт, Ours е зелен.
errors.evidence: Only the 'Ours' bar is a different color (green). The 'QLoRA' bar is the same orange color as the first four bars.
The labeled y-axis range is from 0 to 60. While the tallest bar exceeds this, stating the range is up to 70 is an imprecise description of the axis scale itself.

errors.text_span: The bars representing "Full FT" and "MTL-FT" are colored a light orange
errors.evidence: This statement is misleadingly incomplete as it implies only these two bars are orange. The bars for "TAG", "LoRA", and "QLoRA" are also orange.

errors.text_span: "Full FT" reaching an approximate height of 62 GB
errors.evidence: The bar for "Full FT" reaches a value of approximately 75 GB, significantly higher than the stated 62 GB.
The bar for "MTL-FT" is just below the 40 GB line, at a value of approximately 39 GB, not 44 GB.

errors.text_span: The remaining bars—"TAG," "LoRA," "QLoRA," and "Ours"—are colored in progressively darker shades of green
errors.evidence: This is factually incorrect. The bars for "TAG", "LoRA", and "QLoRA" are orange. Only the "Ours" bar is green. The claim of "progressively darker shades" is a hallucination.
The bar for "TAG" is just above the 20 GB line, at approximately 22 GB, not 38 GB.
The bar for "QLoRA" is well below the 20 GB line, at a value of approximately 13 GB, not 18 GB.
The bar for "Ours" is just above the 20 GB line, with a value of approximately 22 GB, not 16 GB.

This statement is incorrect. The "Ours" bar is visually emphasized by being colored green, which makes it distinct from the five other orange bars. The description should have noted this emphasis instead of explicitly denying it.

The bar for 'Full FT' clearly reaches a value of approximately 75 GB, which is significantly higher than the stated 63 GB.
The bar for 'Full FT' is orange, not yellow. The description is also inconsistent as it later correctly identifies the 'QLoRA' bar as 'Orange'.

errors.text_span: während „Ours“ den geringsten Wert bei etwa 14 GB in Grün aufweist
errors.evidence: This statement contains multiple errors. 'Ours' does not have the lowest value ('geringsten Wert'); 'QLoRA' does. The value for 'Ours' is approximately 22 GB, not 14 GB. The description appears to have confused the 'QLoRA' and 'Ours' bars.

errors.text_span: zeigen aber einen absteigenden Trend von Full FT bis Ours
errors.evidence: The trend is not consistently descending. The value for 'Ours' (approx. 22 GB) is higher than the value for 'QLoRA' (approx. 13 GB), which breaks the stated descending trend.
